response.overview: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare is a three-part Netflix documentary series that chronicles the 2022 murders of four University of Idaho students, focusing on the victims, their families, and the investigation that led to Bryan Kohberger's arrest. Premiering July 29, 2026, the series features unprecedented access to police footage, bodycam video, and interviews with law enforcement and the victims' loved ones, aiming to provide a complete picture of the case.
response.title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
